verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents a REST/JSON API with an API reference page listing OAuth 2.0, Bearer, and personal-access-token security schemes, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Probes of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. The reference page's layout hints that it may be generated from a spec, but no download link is evidenced.
